messages:
Alex: quick sync — OpenWeights wants their 13B model listed in our cloud marketplace and wants redistribution rights for Dedicated customers. We need to lock licensing language, distribution limits, and a launch plan. Can we triage legal + tech constraints today?
Mira (OpenWeights): thanks Alex. high level: partner is OK with marketplace listing and co-marketing, but redistribution terms must be explicit. they prefer a limited redistribution grant (Dedicated only, no further sublicensing). also: export compliance check needed — model training data has some EU-only sources.
Cleo (Legal): got it. need the exact license text they want to grant + any provenance docs. if they insist on redistribution we'll ask for indemnity language and a list of jurisdictions to exclude. also need to know model weights origin (MIT/Apache/custom) and any CC content.
Sam: on the tech side: Dedicated + Private customers will want a quantized artifact and a manifest for HW partners (NVIDIA A100, H100, and Habana). propose we produce a compat matrix and two artifacts: full fp16 and int8-quantized. can we get model shard/format details from OpenWeights?
Mira (OpenWeights): we can provide FP16 .pt and a quantized ONNX export, but the quant file is third-party licensed (QLib). they want us to call out that re-distribution of quantized binaries may be subject to QLib's terms.
Cleo (Legal): call that out in the vendor appendix. we should also require partners to accept a redistribution rider that forbids further sublicensing and requires security patching obligations. i'll draft a short rider.
Liz: marketing note — OpenWeights asked for a joint announcement. we should not promise dates until legal signoff. propose a tentative launch window: 3 weeks from signoff. need a 1-pager from partner + logo assets and embargo plan. can someone own syncing embargo? @calendar-bot can we tentatively hold Mar 18 window?
calendar-bot: tentative hold created for 2026-03-18 10:00-11:00 PT (subject to confirmation).
Alex: action list so far: Cleo to draft rider + export checklist; Sam to create compat matrix + packaging checklist; Mira to send license text and provenance docs; Liz to collect marketing materials and draft announcement timeline. I'll coordinate a quick 30m signoff call tomorrow.
Sam: adding technical note — for SI integrations we should include a small integration README with sample inference Dockerfile and hardware flags, e.g.:
```
FROM ubuntu:22.04
COPY model/ /opt/model/
CMD ["/opt/model/bin/infer", "--device=gpu", "--quant=int8"]
```
keep it minimal so SIs can wrap in their deployment templates.
Mira (OpenWeights): sending license + provenance bundle now (uploading to our shared folder). also can share the QLib license link.
Cleo (Legal): i'll start the rider and export risk memo. FYI if export hits a red flag we may need export control counsel — that'll add a week.
Liz: thank you. once legal gives the green light i'll draft joint blog + tweet cadence. prefer a coordinated press release + partner quote.
Alex: perfect. quick check: are we comfortable with redistribution limited to Dedicated & Private customers only (no marketplace sell-through)? please ack.
Mira (OpenWeights): yes — Dedicated & Private only, no marketplace re-sell.
Cleo (Legal): ack, will include explicit 'no further sublicensing' clause.
Alex: great. meeting invite incoming. thanks everyone :thumbsup:
